name: kraksend-campaigns
title: KrakSend Campaigns
description: Host-protected bilingual campaign creation, scheduling, pause/resume, cancellation, and delivery reporting.
docs: Mount SendCampaignAdmin behind the host admin guard. Supply authorized page/detail/report data, localized messages, and API-backed callbacks. Scheduling snapshots subscribed contacts; completed means fan-out finished, not confirmed delivery. Requires SendAdmin middleware, sender/environment safeguards, campaign workflows/scheduler, and the KrakSend notification dispatch policy. Package export: @krak-stack/registry/send/campaigns. See packages/send/README.md and src/agent-examples/send/campaign.admin.tsx.
